title: Box-and-Whisker Plot
description: A five-number-summary plot above a number line: box from Q1 to Q3, median line, whiskers to min and max. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (one-variable-data): comparing distributions, range/IQR, and median questions.

fiveNumberSummary.description: Must satisfy min <= q1 <= median <= q3 <= max (renderer validates, rejects otherwise).

axisMin.description: Number-line start; must be <= fiveNumberSummary.min (renderer validates).

axisMax.description: Number-line end; must be >= fiveNumberSummary.max (renderer validates).

tickStep.description: Tick spacing; null lets the renderer choose a clean step.

showValues.description: Label min, Q1, median, Q3, max numerically above the plot.

notes: Renderer guarantees: the ordering invariant min<=q1<=median<=q3<=max is enforced at parse time, so a geometrically impossible box plot cannot be drawn; whisker endpoints and quartile edges land exactly on the parameterized values; axis extent always covers the whiskers with at least half a tick of padding.
